Title: French high school protests: 'Young people are not fooled by the discrimination and contempt that society directs at them'

Description: The Canadian writer received the Swedish Academy's highest honor on Thursday, October 8. A master of textual deviation, Carson, who began as a classical philologist, blends poetry and popular culture, prose and verse, with both humor and erudition.

Title: 'Russian journalist Anna Politkovskaya believed that a society that accepts lies ends up accepting violence as well'
Description: Twenty years ago, the journalist was murdered at the instigation of Russian security services. Documentary filmmaker Eric Bergkraut, who knew her well, recalls her fight for truth and against Kremlin propaganda – a struggle that is more necessary than ever as Vladimir Putin continues to kill.

Title: 'The Social Reckoning': Aaron Sorkin dives into toxic effects of Facebook and Instagram

Title: In Los Angeles, Nithya Raman wants to bring the new left to city hall
Description: The 45-year-old Harvard graduate, who was born in India, will face off against LA Mayor Karen Bass on November 3. The Democratic showdown highlights the rise of the socialist movement, championed by New York's Zohran Mamdani and Michigan's Abdul El-Sayed.
